description: This PHP class 'smpl_Account_Sample' generates an account sample document template with static and dynamic content, including company info, addresses, and formatted date.

classes.name: smpl_Account_Sample
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate account sample document content.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the sample, which is 'Accounts'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content of the account sample, including logo, addresses, date, and a disclaimer paragraph.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific footer content.
